title: The Second Primer of Endless Extension
summary: A second primer on lengthening a thrust or a thread of qi without limit so that the reach of the user keeps growing while qi is fed.

title: A Middle Handbook of Accumulating Force
summary: A middle handbook on stacking one effort on another so that force and pressure pile up across a fight.

title: The Course in Inexhaustible Guard
summary: A course on guards that refill as they are spent and on steady restoration that does not run out under long pressure.

title: A Treatise on the Recurring Blow
summary: A treatise on strikes that return on themselves so that one motion repeats and rings again without a second effort.
